verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a cloud phone platform like Aircall, but nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out. The pack covers APIs, webhooks, call routing and AI features. Pausing call recording is a different control and does not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
